provenance.tokens-only-clone: material-web is a tokens-only clone — there is no live M3 snackbar component in either edition (CLAUDE.md). Every structure/behaviour claim here is [R]; every style value below is [S] from tokens/versions/v0_192/_md-comp-snackbar.scss, resolved through _md-sys-color.scss/_md-ref-palette.scss/_md-sys-shape.scss/_md-sys-elevation.scss/_md-sys-typescale.scss.
provenance.item-bg: 'container-color' -> md-sys-color.inverse-surface -> values-light() neutral90 #e6e0e9 / values-dark() neutral20 #322f35 (_md-ref-palette.scss). NOTABLY inverted — M3's snackbar is the first component in this pipeline whose container colour role is a deliberately HIGH-CONTRAST inverted surface (a dark chip on a light page and vice-versa), unlike alert/banner's own same-as-page surface-container.
provenance.item-fg: 'supporting-text-color' -> md-sys-color.inverse-on-surface -> values-light() neutral20 #322f35 / values-dark() neutral95 #f5eff7. Paired with item-bg's own inverse-surface — a genuinely inverted, high-contrast pairing.
provenance.item-shape: 'container-shape' -> md-sys-shape.corner-extra-small -> _md-sys-shape.scss 'corner-extra-small' = 4px. The SMALLEST corner radius any M3 column in this pipeline has used so far (alert's own pinned banner used 0px; the unpinned rich schema used 28px).
provenance.item-elevation: 'container-elevation' -> md-sys-elevation.level3 = 6dp -> this registry's own canonical dp->CSS shadow derivation (docs/foundations/elevation.md's 'M3 dp -> CSS shadow' table): '0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 4px 8px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)'. Shadow colour token 'container-shadow-color' -> md-sys-color.shadow -> neutral0 #000, matching the table's own black-alpha assumption. The HIGHEST elevation level any M3 column in this pipeline has used (alert used level1).
provenance.item-min-height: 'with-single-line-container-height' = 48px. The TWO-LINE variant, 'with-two-lines-container-height' = 68px, is real, sourced and declared OUT OF SCOPE — this template models no line-count axis, the same trim alert.m3.json made for its own six container-height variants.
provenance.type-body: 'supporting-text-{weight,size,line-height,font}' -> md-sys-typescale.body-medium -> weight-regular 400 / 0.875rem / 1.25rem / md-ref-typeface.plain (the literal 'Roboto', self-hosted per every prior M3 column's own precedent).
provenance.action-family-unmodelled: Declared rather than silently ignored: 'action-label-text-*' -> md-sys-typescale.label-large (500 0.875rem/1.25rem Roboto) with colour 'action-label-text-color'/-focus/-hover/-pressed all -> md-sys-color.inverse-primary (light primary40 #6750a4 / dark primary80 #d0bcff), plus matching state-layer colour/opacity triples. NOT modelled as a style row here — action/close compose the registry's own future/already-built button component (slot.composes), the same scope boundary alert.template.json drew for its own actions/close parts. Real, sourced, and available if a per-part action style row is ever added.
provenance.icon-family-is-the-close-button: 'icon-color'/-focus/-hover/-pressed (all -> inverse-on-surface) plus 'icon-size' = 24px is the DISMISS icon-BUTTON family, not a leading status glyph (see structure.icon/structure.close in toast.template.json for the full reasoning — hover/focus/pressed states only make sense on an interactive element). Also unmodelled as a style row, same composition boundary as the action family.

No padding token exists in _md-comp-snackbar.scss (grepped, confirmed absent — that much of the original note was correct), so 16px is a REGISTRY DEFAULT, not an M3-sourced number — matching shadcn's own real, cited `p-4` value rather than inventing an unrelated figure.
